description_expanded: Overview5.0(9 reviews)Hot TubMagnolia By The Sea, Heated Community Pool, 3 Bikes, 4 Minute Walk to Private Beach - BeachWalkThe Space🏖 Beach Walk – Charming 30A Cottage with Serene Outdoor Spaces! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:✔ Short 4-5 Minute Walk to the Beach – Easy access to sugar-white sands & emerald waters✔ Walking Distance to Seacrest & Rosemary Beach Villages – Boutiques, restaurants & local markets nearby✔ Private Backyard & Large Screened-In Porch – Perfect for relaxing with a book, coffee, or cocktail✔ 3 Adult Bikes Included – Explore The Hub, 30A trails & scenic coastal spots✔ Spacious Outdoor Decks & Dining Area – Enjoy alfresco meals under the trees✔ Fully Equipped Kitchen & Open Living Space – Ideal for gatherings & family time✔ Three Comfortable Bedrooms / Three Full Bathrooms – Roomy & thoughtfully designed accommodations✔ Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient✔ Community Pool Access – A refreshing escape just steps away✔ Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained✔ Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to BeachWalkBeach Walk is the quintessential beach cottage surrounded by lovely trees, 2 large private decks – a perfect place to enjoy warm evenings with an evening libation and dining al fresco - or to take a 5-minute stroll to 30A's famous White Sugar White Sand Beaches and Emerald Waters to watch the sunset.You can also comfortably walk to (the east) Seacrest and Rosemary Villages where there are several lovely restaurants, coffee shops, cafes and Boutiques. The Sunday Farmer's Market is a must see as are the world-class galleries and shops. The Hub is a short bike ride away to the west.Enjoy the beach for swimming and soaking up the sun or venture out and go kayaking, stand up paddle boarding and more and make sure to visit our beautiful Dune Lakes. From here it is just a hop, skip, and a jump where the wonders of the gulf come alive.Park your car in the driveway of this 3 bedroom, 3 bath, 1550 square foot cottage, enter the front door to the kitchen that adjoins the living and dining area and find yourself in a sunny, spacious great room with lots of windows complimented by hardwood floors that add to the welcoming warmth.There is a large private screened in porch off the living room with plenty of comfy seating to cozy up with a loved one, book, glass of wine or all the above. Just off the is the gas grill ready for your families culinary delights. In the living room you'll find comfortable seating and a large flat screen TV so you and your family or guests can catch up with each other, watch a movie after an active day at the beach or exploring the area. Cable and WI-FI are included.The dining area, adjacent to the living area comfortably seats 6 with additional seating for 4 at the breakfast bar. The fully equipped kitchen, with its new appliances has a dishwasher, refrigerator/freezer, and an oven and all small appliances for all your cooking and eating needs. All you need do is add the food and the camaraderie.There are 3 bedrooms – the master suite has a king bed, a flat screen TV, and en suite bath on the second floor, off the master bedroom is a private deck with 2 chaise lounges and a cafe table with seating for two to enjoy morning coffee. The 2nd bedroom has a king bed, TV, ensuite, lots of closet space. The 3rd bedroom has two bunks - two twin beds, two queen beds and lots of windows making it feel light and airy and TV. There is a large double door closet and full bath across the hall.Beach Walk -- This spacious and newly remodeled house is literally just a "Beach Walk" away from the private beach access located right across the street. Beach Walk is located in the Magnolia by the Sea neighborhood, a quaint community in the heart of the quintessential village towns of 30A. This home features a screened in patio, a fully equipped kitchen, access to the community pool, and 3 bikes.We don't know what's more tempting about this beautiful home – the short walk to the beach, or the serene and private back yard lined with lush trees and a screened in porch with plenty of comfortable seating. No matter what your formula is for relaxation and recharging, Beach Walk is the perfect spot along Scenic 30A for your vacation needs.Retreat to one of the three well designed and thoughtfully decorated spacious bedrooms or spend time with your family and friends in the large open living room, around the dining room, or in one of the beautiful outdoor living spaces this home offers. You'll have plenty to do at the pool and on the beach, or you can take a short bike ride to The Hub or Rosemary Beach. Whatever your beach vacation desires, they are sure to be met when you book your stay at Beach Walk. Your vacation retreat awaits and is just a click or call away. Reserve today and prepare to create memories of a lifetime!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Sleeps 10Master Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom - Two sets bunk beds, twin over twin and full over fullAREA ATTRACTIONS:Welcome to the Magnolia Cottages by the Sea! These beautiful properties have been designed by award winning architects and make up one of the most perfect beach cottage communities in the area. The community offers a pool, a bocce court, a horseshoe pit and a private boardwalk to the beach. If you will be using a golf cart for the week, no worries as the community offers private golf cart parking along the beach. Magnolia Cottages is the perfect location for your next family vacation, there is truly something for everyone down here!Show less
